arj Posted by arj on Wed 11 of Apr., 2007 21:06 GMT posts: 953
It was suggested by Jorge in the thread about irrealis attitudinals that we should postpone the issue for now, and move on to other sections until we've gained some momentum.

To gain momentum, it is important that everyone is working together, because toiling away in one's own little corner has a tendency of quickly becoming boring. So, IMO the right medicine now is to get to work on another checkpoint.

I suggest we do Pro-sumti first. It's not all easy (like BAI), nor staggeringly complicated (like MEX), so we shouldn't start to get bored, or caught up in a web of conflicting issues that one needs to have a PhD to disentangle.

What do you say?
